calc_region_bbox: calculate the region of a bounding box defined by a ratio from center to every edge
anchor_ctr_inside_region_flags: get boolean flags indicating whether anchor centers are inside specified regions
create_RegionAssigner: create a RegionAssigner instance with configurable center and ignore ratio parameters for anchor assignment
assign_gt_to_anchors: assign ground truth bounding boxes to anchors using region-based positive and negative sampling
review_RegionAssigner_assign: review the RegionAssigner assign method to understand the five-step anchor assignment algorithm
